suggestions.title: John Wick
suggestions.description: They took his car. They killed his dog. Big mistake. Keanu Reeves' legendary hitman comes out of retirement for one relentless night of vengeance, and action cinema never looks back. Chad Stahelski and David Leitch — both former stuntmen — stage the gun-fu ballet with brutal elegance, while the film quietly builds one of the most stylish underworld mythologies ever put on screen. Pure, adrenaline-charged catharsis that rewrote the rules of the modern action movie.

suggestions.title: The Conjuring
suggestions.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on their most terrifying case yet: a Rhode Island farmhouse where a family is tormented by a malevolent presence. James Wan's old-school haunted-house masterclass trades cheap gore for patience and dread, building scares with masterful craft. Anchored by Patrick Wilson and Vera Farmiga's warm, believable couple, it spawned an entire cinematic universe — and it remains the scariest chapter in it.

suggestions.title: Hereditary
suggestions.description: After the death of her secretive mother, Annie Graham watches her family unravel in ways that feel achingly real before spiraling into full nightmare. Ari Aster's debut is a slow-burn family tragedy disguised as a horror film, anchored by Toni Collette's career-best, awards-caliber performance. Its imagery lingers long after the credits — the most unsettling horror debut of the decade, and a film that rewards patient viewers with pure dread.
